product.name: Chrome Valley Customs
product.description: A mobile game focused on designing and customizing vintage vehicles, allowing players to run their own garage.

product.name: Beatstar - Touch Your Music
product.description: A rhythm game that lets players interact with music from various artists by tapping and swiping to the beat.

product.name: Transformers: Earth Wars
product.description: A real-time combat strategy game that features characters from the Transformers franchise.

product.name: Rival Kingdoms
product.description: A game where players build bases, forge kingdoms, and battle enemies in a fantasy setting.

product.name: Fastlane: Road to Revenge
product.description: An arcade shooter game with a retro style, featuring urban themes and music-inspired elements.

product.name: Samurai Siege
product.description: A game focused on real-time battle and alliance rivalries, set in a mystical world, which was retired in 2020.
